classification_rule: Every discovered pre-V3 Gold surface is ledgered with platform-invariant case-insensitive discovery. Explicit GOVERNANCE_ONLY surfaces may have zero fact matches. Explicit INTERFACE_CONTRACT_ONLY surfaces may have zero fact matches only when their exact schema hash and top-level field contract pass the audited Gold interface registry. Any other discovered/required Gold surface with zero registered fact matches is UNACCOUNTED and fails closed.
zero_unaccounted_definition: All required authority surfaces exist; no non-governance/non-interface Gold surface is unmatched; every interface-only schema is exact-hash and field-contract audited; all registered facts are semantically classified. Registry entries intentionally extending V2/Vault science are permitted and do not pretend prior-Vault provenance. P02 live-source coverage remains out of scope.
